subject: R: How to cbind 2 data frames in this specific case

messages.author: 1b13ff6a69693e4b
messages.subject: R: How to cbind 2 data frames in this specific case
parts:
Hi all, 

I have 2 very big data frames that have coordinates x and y, and I want to bring some columns (in this case is just NDVI, in my real data frame I have 13 columns) of the dataframe "b" into the dataframe "a" only if those coordinates x and y match. Here is a reproducible example:

v<-c(rep(1, times=3), rep(2, times=3), rep(3, times=3))
a <- data.frame("x" = rep(c(10:12), times=3), "y"=v, "NDVI" = rep(c("0.5", "0.6", "0.7"), times=3))

> a
   x y NDVI
1 10 1  0.5
2 11 1  0.6
3 12 1  0.7
4 10 2  0.5
5 11 2  0.6
6 12 2  0.7
7 10 3  0.5
8 11 3  0.6
9 12 3  0.7

w<-c(rep(3, times=3), rep(4, times=3), rep(5, times=3))
b <- data.frame("x" = rep(c(10:12), times=3), "y"=w, "NDVI" = rep(c("0.8", "0.9", "0.95"), times=3))

> b
   x y NDVI
1 10 3  0.8
2 11 3  0.9
3 12 3 0.95
4 10 4  0.8
5 11 4  0.9
6 12 4 0.95
7 10 5  0.8
8 11 5  0.9
9 12 5 0.95

The only x and y values that are the same in both data frames are x=10:12 and y=3
If I use merge, I only get those 3 rows, but what I want is to add the new value to the data frame "a", and when there is no match just put NA

merge(a, b, by.x= c("x", "y"), by.y= c("x", "y"))

   x y NDVI.x NDVI.y
1 10 3    0.5    0.8
2 11 3    0.6    0.9
3 12 3    0.7   0.95

I can't use cbind because I don't have the same amount of rows and in the same order...

What I want to get is this:
   x y NDVI NDVI.b
1 10 1  0.5     NA
2 11 1  0.6     NA
3 12 1  0.7     NA
4 10 2  0.5     NA
5 11 2  0.6     NA
6 12 2  0.7     NA
7 10 3  0.5   0.80
8 11 3  0.6   0.90
9 12 3  0.7   0.95

Any ideas on how to do this? Any help is much appreciated!
Best,
Ana

messages.subject: Re: [D-RUG]: R: How to cbind 2 data frames in this specific case
parts: I think you're looking for a left join; the best implementation is in tidyverse:

v<-c(rep(1, times=3), rep(2, times=3), rep(3, times=3))
a <- data.frame("x" = rep(c(10:12), times=3), "y"=v, "NDVI" = rep(c("0.5", "0.6", "0.7"), times=3))

w<-c(rep(3, times=3), rep(4, times=3), rep(5, times=3))
b <- data.frame("x" = rep(c(10:12), times=3), "y"=w, "NDVI" = rep(c("0.8", "0.9", "0.95"), times=3))

library(tidyverse)
left_join(a, b, by=c('x', 'y'))
   x y NDVI.x NDVI.y

1 10 1    0.5   <NA>
2 11 1    0.6   <NA>
3 12 1    0.7   <NA>
4 10 2    0.5   <NA>
5 11 2    0.6   <NA>
6 12 2    0.7   <NA>
7 10 3    0.5    0.8

messages.author: e0691e26c9cf72eb
messages.subject: Re: [geospatial] R: How to cbind 2 data frames in this specific case
parts:
Add the argument all.x=TRUE which will keep all rows from x (aka a in
this case)

merge(a, b, by.x= c("x", "y"), by.y= c("x", "y"), all.x=TRUE)

Thanks,
Alex Mandel, PhD

Center for Spatial Sciences
https://spatial.ucdavis.edu
Geospatial and Farming Systems Research Consortium
https://gfc.ucdavis.edu
University of California, Davis
